about: A graph as at a date on its two kinds of time (editor spec §29, two_kinds_of_time): recorded time (recorded_at, and SUPERSEDES) and real-world time (valid_from up to valid_to). Each case runs its lens on the block as at each date on each axis; the buckets must be those named, from asAt (packages/graph-spec/src/mesh/as-at.js) and as_at (python/graph_spec/src/graphspec/engine/mesh/as_at.py) alike.
block: (ann:Person {name: 'Ann', role: 'junior', recorded_at: DATE '2024-01-10', valid_from: DATE '2023-06-01', valid_to: DATE '2024-03-01'}),
(ben:Person {name: 'Ben', role: 'senior', recorded_at: DATE '2024-02-01', valid_from: DATE '2022-01-01', valid_to: DATE '2024-05-01'}),
lens: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.id AS id, CASE WHEN p.role = 'senior' THEN 'senior' ELSE 'other' END AS grp

cases.name: recorded time: before Ann's promotion was written down, the graph says she is junior
recorded time: once it is written, her new record supersedes the old
recorded time: before anything was written, only what carries no time is there
real-world time: in April 2024 Ann was already senior, though it was written later
real-world time: in July 2023 Ann was junior
real-world time: after Ben left, he is not in the graph
